title: Stafford’s $55M Extension Makes Him NFL’s First $500M Player

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Stafford’s $55M Extension Makes Him NFL’s First $500M Player
sources.description: Fresh off the first MVP season of his 17-year NFL career, the Los Angeles Rams signed Matthew Stafford to a one-year, $55 million contract extension that ties him to the Rams through the 2027 season with $105 million in remaining compensation, according to ESPN’s Adam Schefter. The move, assuming Stafford returns for the 2027 season, …
